name: contact_id
label: Contact ID
help: Only this contact's appointments. Use Search contacts first to find a contact by phone number.

name: starts_after
label: Starts after
help: Only appointments that start at or after this time, such as now for upcoming ones.

name: starts_before
label: Starts before
help: Only appointments that start before this time.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of results to return and work with during one execution cycle.
